use_when.text: Say what can be searched in the hint, such as ‘Search jobs or companies’.
Keep the search input easy to find and accessible within the interface.
Keep the entered query visible while users review or refine results.
Search as users type only when it feels responsive and doesn’t disrupt their input.

dont_use_when.text: Don’t clear the query unexpectedly when results update or users return to the field.
Don’t make users guess whether they need to press Enter or wait for automatic results.
Don’t clear the query unexpectedly when results refresh, the user navigates back, or the field loses focus.
Don’t use the search field for unrelated actions, such as filtering a form section or entering a URL, without making that purpose clear.

a11y.text: Renders no visible label; labelText is the input’s placeholder and its aria-label.
The field is a native <input>; state="disable" sets disabled.
state="error" sets aria-invalid on the input.
